2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/RONDO RETREAT/Rondo RETREAT RESIDENT RATES 2026.pdf
validity: 2026 (no specific date range stated beyond the year)
notes: A faith-based retreat centre (Trinity Fellowship ministry), not a typical commercial safari lodge - management explicitly reserves the right to admit or not admit children.
SS = Single Supplement/Single Sharing (single occupancy rate).

childPolicy.raw: No single supplement for children under 12 - must share.

christmasSurcharge_residentCard.raw: KES2,000 per person for the ENTIRE 24-26 December season (not per day). No check-in or check-out on Christmas Day.

policies.depositWindow: 2 weeks to receive deposit after invoice, or dates may be released
policies.checkOut: 10:00, otherwise a half-board fee is charged for the room
policies.roomReleaseTime: 19:00 (rooms held only until then unless late arrival notified)
policies.cancellation_individual: 30-15 days: 30% of applicable rate per night; 14-2 days: 60%; within 48 hours or non-arrival: 100% of reservation value
policies.cancellation_blockBooking10plusPax: Up to 2 months before arrival: 50% of applicable rate per person per night; up to 30 days before arrival: 100%
policies.residentVerification: Must present Driving License or other ID on arrival
policies.liability: No liability for lost/damaged property or personal injury (valuables can be deposited at Front Desk for safekeeping)
